messages:
maria-g: Hey @people-ops — quick Q. I'm planning to move from NY to TX in mid-May. Do I need to update anything besides my address in Workday? Also curious how the WFH stipend and state tax withholding get handled when I change states.

people-ops: Congrats on the move! :tada: Short answers: yes, please update your primary address in Workday and submit a Location Change form.

people-ops: For the WFH stipend — eligible employees get a monthly stipend. If you move mid-cycle we pro-rate for that month. Submit the relocation/date in the form and we can calculate the pro‑rata amount.

maria-g: Great. Who runs the pro-rate calc? Is that payroll or people-ops?

payroll-bot: @maria-g — payroll will handle the pro‑rata adjustment after people-ops submits the effective date. Expected turnaround: 1 pay period.

olivia-tax: Quick tax note: TX has no state income tax — good for you — but please confirm your move date. Payroll will need a new state withholding form if you were using NY withholding. Also if you end up working remotely from another state for >120 days/year we need to flag it for nexus review.

maria-g: Move date is 2026-05-15. Will submit the Location Change form now. Is manager approval required?

samir: +1 from me. Approving remote move — just FYI, if you change timezone drastically we should sync on on-call and meeting times.

people-ops: Thanks @samir. Maria, when you submit the form choose: "Relocation — domestic" and include the exact move date and new home address. We'll: 1) update HRIS, 2) notify payroll to update tax withholding and pro‑rate stipend, 3) notify benefits enrollment if there are plan implications.

maria-g: Done — form submitted (link: https://hr.internal/forms/location-change/1769773333).

payroll-bot: Received Location Change form for maria-g. Queueing payroll tasks: update W-4/state withholding, pro-rate WFH stipend, verify benefits county eligibility. ETA: 3 business days.

olivia-tax: I logged a Nexus Watch ticket for Finance to review (possible reporting if headcount changes in TX). Ticket #FIN-4982. If you remain the only employee in TX it usually isn't an immediate problem but Finance will confirm.

people-ops: One more practical item: please attach a photo of your signed lease or utility bill in the form to speed verification if asked by payroll/benefits.

maria-g: Thanks everyone. Do I need to update any equipment shipping addresses for the $500 one-time remote setup stipend?

people-ops: Good call — include the preferred shipping address on the form. The one-time stipend is paid after confirmation of shipping address and equipment receipt.

samir: If you want, we can shift recurring 1:1 to earlier EST-friendly time slot now that you'll be CST-adjacent.

maria-g: Appreciate it. I'll ping @samir to reschedule. Thanks team! :smile:
